title: Underprescribing in Geriatric Patients: a Prevalence Study and Analysis of Factors Contributing to Potential Prescription Omissions (Under-PRES)
official: Underprescribing in Geriatric Patients: a Prevalence Study and Analysis of Factors Contributing to Potential Prescription Omissions (Under-PRES)
summary: This observational study will determine the prevalence of underprescription in a cohort of elderly patients, recruited at the time of an outpatient geriatric visit, or hospitalized, upon admission to a geriatric ward.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Geriatric ward admission or outpatient geriatric appointment
* Capacity to provide informed consent by the patient or legal guardian

Exclusion Criteria:

* Limited life expectancy as measured by the Clinical Frailty Scale (CFS) \>8
sponsor: Istituto Nazionale di Ricovero e Cura per Anziani
